name: rules-rtdb-r10-snapshot-type-guards
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r10-snapshot-type-guards" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). structure and type guards are the backbone of RTDB validation rules, and `parent()` re-projects a field snapshot at its record node — the simulator must resolve both the type predicates and the upward path climb exactly as production does.
